title: Uploaded, not ready
fullTitle: 100% Uploaded. Why Isn't My File Ready?

scenes.narration: The bar says one hundred percent. The file is not ready. Nothing is wrong with the bar. It was measuring something else.
captions: The bar says 100%. The file is not ready.
Nothing is wrong with the bar. It measured something else.

scenes.narration: An upload is four stages. Transfer: the request body leaves the browser. Acceptance: the server answers with a status. Processing: a worker parses the file. Availability: the result can be fetched. The bar only showed the first.
captions: Four stages: transfer, acceptance, processing, availability.
The bar only showed the first.

scenes.narration: Browser upload progress comes from XMLHttpRequest upload events: loaded over total, only when the total is computable. Those bytes are the request body, multipart overhead included. Here an eighty-two byte file travelled as two hundred and thirty-two bytes.
captions: XHR upload events: loaded / total, only if lengthComputable.
Those are request-body bytes, multipart overhead included.
An 82-byte file travelled as a 232-byte request body.

scenes.narration: After the last byte, the response arrives separately: two oh two, Accepted, with a job ID. Accepted means stored and queued, not processed. Asking for the result now returns four oh nine.
captions: After the last byte, the response arrives separately: 202 Accepted + job ID.
Accepted means stored and queued, not processed. Result now: 409.

scenes.narration: Polling the authorised status endpoint, the job moves from accepted to ready. Only then does the result open: three rows, total one hundred and fourteen point seven five. Another user asking for the same job gets four oh four.
captions: Polling the authorised status endpoint: accepted → ready.
Only then does the result open. Another user gets 404.

scenes.narration: Same flow, different file. It transfers fully and is accepted, two oh two. Then the worker finds a bad email on line three and a non-numeric amount on line four. The job fails, with a reason. The bar had still said one hundred percent.
captions: Same flow, different file: 100% transferred, 202 Accepted.
The worker finds bad rows. Job failed, with a reason.

scenes.narration: So replace the single bar with four statuses. Transfer, from upload events. Accepted, from the HTTP status. Processing, as a plain state with no invented percentage. Available, only when ready. And remember: parsing is not malware scanning.
captions: Replace the single bar with four statuses.
Processing is a plain state: no invented percentage.

scenes.narration: Bytes transferred is not the same as work completed.
captions: Bytes transferred is not the same as work completed.
